excludedRepositories.reason: Work in this repository is exclusive to that repository and must not be copied into or out of the Premium parity program.

visualContract.background: explicit dark surface on every root, overlay, dialog, loading state, and transition frame
visualContract.navigation: adaptive rail or sidebar on wide layouts and compact bottom navigation on narrow layouts
visualContract.commandSearch: searchable destination command surface with keyboard shortcut where the platform supports hardware keyboards
visualContract.mediaGrid: compact responsive poster cards; Windows targets eight cards per desktop row and mobile adapts by width
visualContract.motion: cohesive motion without full-screen blur plus scale composition; reduced-motion preference must be honored
visualContract.errorState: branded dark recovery surface that preserves data and provides a safe return path

optionParity.rule: Every user-visible option introduced on one included platform must be represented on the other included platforms unless the contract records an explicit platform limitation and equivalent control.

defectParity.title: Menu transition white or pale screen
defectParity.requiredOutcome: Navigation cannot strand the interface on a blank surface; root surfaces stay dark and failures recover safely.

defectParity.title: Ctrl or Command K command surface compositor stall
defectParity.requiredOutcome: The command surface uses an opaque dark background and avoids full-screen backdrop blur combined with scale transforms.

defectParity.title: Source added without immediate scan
defectParity.requiredOutcome: Adding or authorizing a source initiates validation, scan, enrichment, and visible library refresh.

defectParity.title: Metadata or poster not appearing on media card
defectParity.requiredOutcome: Enrichment persists artwork and metadata and refreshes the visible card without restart.

defectParity.title: Oversized one-card-per-row library
defectParity.requiredOutcome: The library uses compact adaptive poster cards with dense layouts appropriate to the device width.

defectParity.title: Remote API exposes file names or local paths
defectParity.requiredOutcome: Remote clients receive opaque media keys and authenticated URLs only; local paths are never returned.

defectParity.title: Remote connection unavailable behind NAT
defectParity.requiredOutcome: Clients show automatic direct traversal status and use an HTTPS relay fallback when direct access is unavailable.

defectParity.title: Rendering failure blanks entire application
defectParity.requiredOutcome: A platform-appropriate error boundary or recovery host preserves settings and library state and offers safe recovery.

defectParity.title: Platform design or option drift
defectParity.requiredOutcome: Design, functions, and user-visible options are compared against this contract in CI before release.

changePolicy.releaseRule: A Windows design, function, option, or defect change creates matching Android and iOS parity work before the parity program is considered complete.
